ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark-spectrum pixels with high-intensity clusters localized exclusively at the distal tips and trailing edge margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity (black/dark-grey) contiguous surface across approximately 90% of the visible area; heterogeneous high-intensity pixel clusters (white, tan) mapped to the far lateral tips and periodic intervals along the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an estimated 45-50 degree interior angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes of 5-20 pixels occurring along the continuous trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to the trailing margins of both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-contrast pixel groupings (white/brown) located at both fluke tips and intermittently along the posterior boundary.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single faint, diagonal linear mark (low-contrast grey) on the right lobe surface extending toward the notch area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral barnacle colonization causing significant jagged deformation of the natural fluke silhouette at the distal tips.
